report:
(A) Left ovary, cystectomy; peritoneal biopsies
(B) Peritoneum, pelvic, biopsy

(A) The specimen consists of a left cystectomy specimen received fragmented (45 g, 70 x 50 x 30 mm). The left ovary is replaced by a cystic mass measuring 60 mm in greatest dimension (60 x 45 x 30 mm). The outer surface is smooth. Cut surface shows a unilocular cyst, serous fluid and papillary excrescences on the inner surface.

(A1-5) Cyst wall with papillary areas.
(A6) Pelvic peritoneal biopsy.

(A) Left ovary, cystectomy; peritoneal biopsies
Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Left ovarian cystectomy; peritoneal biopsies
- Specimen integrity (left ovary): Fragmented
- Tumour site: Left ovary
- Ovarian surface involvement: Not identified
- Fallopian tube surface involvement: Not identified
- Tumour size: 60 mm in greatest dimension (60 x 45 x 30 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Serous borderline tumour
- Histologic grade: Not applicable (borderline tumour)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a serous borderline tumour. The tumour is composed of slender, irregularly contoured papillae with fibrous to oedematous cores showing hierarchical branching, the larger papillae arborising into progressively smaller papillae that terminate in detached epithelial tufts and single cells. The lining epithelium is stratified and crowded with hobnailing and a mixed population of cuboidal, columnar, ciliated and eosinophilic cells, showing mild to moderate nuclear atypia with coarsened chromatin and small nucleoli. Mitotic figures are sparse, psammomatous calcification is present and there is no stromal invasion. The peritoneal implants consist of hierarchically branching papillary tufts without supporting stroma, lying on the mesothelial surface and within cystic mesothelial invaginations, with a smooth, non-destructive interface with the underlying tissue.
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- p53 immunohistochemistry: Not performed
- Implants: Present, non-invasive epithelial (pelvic peritoneum)
- Largest extrapelvic peritoneal focus: Not applicable
- Peritoneal / ascitic fluid: Malignant cells not identified
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Pelvic peritoneum

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: Not submitted

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Additional findings
- None
